definition: a building where grain is made into flour
description: A tall old stone mill building stands beside a river in evening light, with a big wooden waterwheel turning under rushing white water at its base. A young red-haired woman swings out from an upper doorway on a rope, sitting on a sack and laughing, and swings down over the waterwheel, while a cloud of white flour bursts from the loft door above her. Two men lean out of the doorway reaching towards her, a horse and cart stand on the left and birds fly over the roof.
